summary.text: Raygan Angel is the Democratic candidate for the North Carolina State Senate, District 37, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Vickie Sawyer (R).
Angel won the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary with 62.5% of the vote over Precinda Bjorgen.
